title: State of LLMs — Q2 2026
summary: A complete quarterly overview of the frontier AI landscape. Which models now lead, what shifted this quarter, the three biggest trends shaping the next three months, and what a non-technical professional actually needs to know right now.

insights.label: Model of the quarter
insights.text: Claude 4 Opus marks the clearest quality jump in long-form reasoning since GPT-4's original release.

insights.label: Biggest trend
insights.text: Agentic workflows crossed from experiment to production. AI is no longer just answering questions — it's completing tasks end-to-end.

insights.label: To watch in Q3
insights.text: Multimodal reasoning — models that see, hear, and read simultaneously — moves from demo to daily tool.

title: State of LLMs — Q1 2026
summary: The first quarter of 2026 saw DeepSeek's continued momentum, the emergence of reasoning models as standard offerings, and the first real signs of agentic AI moving into enterprise workflows.

insights.label: Model of the quarter
insights.text: Gemini 2.5 Pro surprised the market with its 1M token context window becoming genuinely useful in production.

insights.label: Biggest trend
insights.text: Reasoning models shifted from specialist tools to default offerings — every major lab now has one.

insights.label: To watch in Q2
insights.text: Claude 4 Opus release and whether Anthropic can retake the writing quality crown from OpenAI.

title: State of LLMs — Q4 2025
summary: Q4 2025 was defined by the open model revolution — Llama 3.3 and DeepSeek V3 reached near-frontier performance, democratising access to capable AI for the first time.

insights.label: Model of the quarter
insights.text: DeepSeek V3 — open weight, near-frontier capability, and training cost that shocked the industry.

insights.label: Biggest trend
insights.text: Open weight models reached professional viability. The gap between open and closed models narrowed dramatically.

insights.label: To watch in Q1 2026
insights.text: Whether Western labs respond to DeepSeek's efficiency gains with architectural changes of their own.
